step1_analysis.description: A switched-capacitor circuit that performs analog color signal processing (such as color correction or white balance) by computing a weighted sum of the input color signals (Red, Green, Blue) during the charge transfer phase.

paper_reference.title: Single-Chip CMOS Image Sensor for Mobile Applications

voltage_gain_r.description: Voltage gain from the Red channel input to the output

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the capacitor ratio Cr/Cf
sky130_expected.reasoning: Programmable capacitor ratios are typically used for white balance and color correction, ranging from fractional to small integer gains.

voltage_gain_g.description: Voltage gain from the Green channel input to the output

sky130_expected.calculation: Determined by the capacitor ratio Cg/Cf
sky130_expected.reasoning: Green often carries the luminance information and may have a higher weighting in the matrix.

settling_time.description: Time required for the output to settle to 99% of its final value after charge transfer begins

sky130_expected.calculation: Depends on the op-amp bandwidth and the feedback factor (Cf / (Cf + Cr + Cg + Cb))
sky130_expected.reasoning: For a 30 frames/s sensor, the pixel clock is typically in the 10-20 MHz range, requiring settling times well under 50ns.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to verify the switched-capacitor charge transfer and weighted summing operation. The abstract components from the netlist are replaced with runnable SPICE equivalents (VCVS and voltage-controlled switch).
step3_testbench.spice:
* Switched-Capacitor Summing Amplifier Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param C_f=1p C_r=1p C_g=2p C_b=1p

* Runnable equivalent of the abstract DUT
E1 Vout GND GND N0 10000
Cf N0 Vout {C_f}
Cr N0 _Vr {C_r}
Cg N0 Vg {C_g}
Cb N0 _Vb {C_b}
S1 N0 Vout clk GND switch_model
.model switch_model SW(Vt=0.9 Ron=100 Roff=1G)

* Stimulus
* Phase 1 (Reset): clk is high, inputs are sampled.
* Phase 2 (Evaluate): clk goes low, inputs are grounded, transferring charge to Cf.
V_Vr _Vr GND pwl(0 0.5 9n 0.5 10n 0)
V_Vg Vg GND pwl(0 0.3 9n 0.3 10n 0)
V_Vb _Vb GND pwl(0 0.2 9n 0.2 10n 0)
V_clk clk GND pwl(0 1.8 5n 1.8 6n 0)

.control
tran 0.1n 20n

* Measure final settled voltage
* Expected Vout = (Cr*0.5 + Cg*0.3 + Cb*0.2)/Cf = (0.5 + 0.6 + 0.2) = 1.3V
meas tran vout_final find v(Vout) at=18n

* Measure settling time (99% of 1.3V is 1.287V)
meas tran t_settle trig v(_Vr) val=0.25 fall=1 targ v(Vout) val=1.287 rise=1

print vout_final
quit
.endc
.end
